chosen_args.why_stop: Stopped because S1-S3 are satisfied: candidate_13 is the lowest-cost feasible optimized candidate; every other candidate is either optimized or screened by the declared dominance rule; and the highest-activity candidate candidate_04 has an updated parity multiplier and reachability classification. Remaining affordable calculations have low expected decision value: exact model-validity checking and MC uncertainty are unaffordable, while further local refinements would not plausibly overturn the 7.03 USD/t gap to candidate_04 or the screening logic.

unresolved_decision_risk.descriptor_uncertainty_MC: Not run; 100-draw MC for three optimized candidates would exceed remaining budget. Descriptor uncertainty remains an unquantified risk, especially for candidate_13, but nominal dominance and the cost gap are strong.
unresolved_decision_risk.full_domain_coverage: Full admissible domain was not exhaustively built. Targeted windows followed observed edge movement; final candidate_13 pressure is interior to the bridge window and bed volume is well below the 90 m3 cap. Tsep=30 C is the admissible upper boundary, so no warmer separator state exists.
unresolved_decision_risk.model_validity_checks: Generic CHECK_MODEL_VALIDITY costs 28 CU and was unaffordable. Bed-cap risk is low for candidate_13 because bed_m3=17.06 versus cap 90. Very small bed volumes for candidate_04/candidate_05 could affect their vessel-floor validity, but that would not improve them relative to candidate_13.
unresolved_decision_risk.parity_risk: Low: candidate_04 would need 201.2x intrinsic activity improvement, while the frozen scaling manifold offers at most 2.52x across process states, so parity by intrinsic activity alone is unreachable.
